subject: Physics
title: Conservation of Momentum
lines: In an isolated system with no external forces, total momentum is conserved.
Elastic collisions conserve both momentum and kinetic energy.
Inelastic collisions conserve momentum but not kinetic energy.

subject: Computer Science
title: Stack and Queue Data Structures
lines: A stack follows LIFO ordering: last element pushed is first popped.
A queue follows FIFO ordering: first element enqueued is first dequeued.
Both can be implemented with arrays or linked lists.

subject: Chemistry
title: Chemical Equilibrium and Le Chatelier
lines: At equilibrium the forward and reverse reaction rates are equal.
Le Chatelier's principle predicts shifts when a stress is applied.
Increasing concentration of a reactant shifts equilibrium toward products.

subject: Biology
title: DNA Replication Basics
lines: DNA replication is semiconservative: each new double helix has one old and one new strand.
Helicase unwinds the double helix at the replication fork.
DNA polymerase synthesizes the new strand in the 5' to 3' direction.

subject: Physics
title: Work and Energy Theorem
lines: Work equals force times displacement times cosine of the angle between them.
The work-energy theorem states net work equals change in kinetic energy.
Conservative forces have path-independent work.

subject: Chemistry
title: Exothermic and Endothermic Reactions
lines: Exothermic reactions release heat and have positive delta H.
Endothermic reactions absorb heat from surroundings.
Activation energy is the minimum energy required to start a reaction.

seeded_mistakes.student_claim: Exothermic reactions release heat and have positive delta H
seeded_mistakes.correct_fact: Exothermic reactions have negative delta H (they release energy)

subject: Biology
title: Photosynthesis Light Reactions
lines: Light reactions occur in the stroma of the chloroplast.
Water is split during photolysis releasing oxygen.
ATP and NADPH are produced for the Calvin cycle.

seeded_mistakes.student_claim: Light reactions occur in the stroma
seeded_mistakes.correct_fact: Light reactions occur in the thylakoid membrane, not the stroma

subject: Physics
title: Gravitational Potential Energy
lines: Gravitational potential energy is mgh where h is measured from any reference level.
Objects in free fall gain potential energy as they descend.
At the lowest point of a pendulum swing kinetic energy is maximum.

seeded_mistakes.student_claim: Objects in free fall gain potential energy as they descend
seeded_mistakes.correct_fact: Objects in free fall lose potential energy and gain kinetic energy as they descend

subject: Computer Science
title: Sorting Algorithm Code
lines: def bubble_sort(arr):
for i in range(len(arr)):
for j in range(len(arr) - i - 1):
if arr[j] > arr[j+1]:
arr[j], arr[j+1] = arr[j+1], arr[j]

subject: Computer Science
title: Minimalist One-Liner
lines: Hash tables provide O(1) average lookup.

subject: Physics
title: Out-of-Corpus Astrophysics
lines: Black holes form when stellar cores exceed the Tolman-Oppenheimer-Volkoff limit.
Hawking radiation is a quantum effect near the event horizon.
Gravitational lensing bends light from distant galaxies.

subject: Biology
title: Out-of-Corpus Marine Ecology
lines: Coral bleaching occurs when symbiotic zooxanthellae are expelled due to thermal stress.
Ocean acidification reduces carbonate ion availability for shell-forming organisms.
